title: Language Models Should be Used to Surface the Unwritten Code of Science and Society

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting implicit heuristics in peer review by prompting LLMs to generate hypotheses explaining score discrepancies between paired conference papers. The methodology compares the LLM's prior normative assumptions (e.g., favoring theoretical rigor) with posterior findings (e.g., implicitly favoring storytelling, presentation, and contextualization) that actually explain human review score differences.
